'''Harvest Bay''' was the oceanic region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cols/Legends|Cols]] that served as the main breeding ground for the [[kalaide]]s.<ref name="COG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
